content: Nidjiki8eg! Enigokodeeian nikitci nda8enimag Israel a8iagog kidji ani ag8acimagani8i8adj. Nipagosenima Kije Manido ii odji.
Nikikenimag e kitci k8ag8e ijitcige8adj kidji min8endamia8adjin Kije Manidon, ka8in dac teb8e okikendasina8a adi ke todamo8adj.

Ka8in mega ododji nisidotasina8a adi ka todamindjin Kije Manidon kidji k8aiak8abamandjin a8iagon, acitc ogi nanada8i todana8a kidji odji k8aiak8abamigo8adjin. Ka8in dac ododji odapinasina8a adi ka todamindjin Kije Manidon kidji k8aiak8abamandjin a8iagon.
Jesos Christ mega ogi ojiton kidji poni abadanigin Coda8inni Inakonige8inan. Midac kakina a8iagon ka teb8etagodjin, mi ini8eni8an Kije Manido ka k8aiak8abamadjin.
Kakina a8iag ke teb8etamog8en kada ag8acimagani8i
Igi8e ka k8ag8edjito8adj kidji k8aiak8abamigo8adjin Kije Manidon e nosoneamo8adjin Coda8inni Inakonige8inan, mikomagani8i8ag Mois odojibiiganikag. Ogi ojibian dac oo8eni:
Igi8e dac ka teb8eta8a8adjin Kije Manidon kidji odji k8aiak8abamigo8adjin, okikendana8a e teb8emaganig oo8e ka ojibiigadenigobanen:

A8enen ke iji najada8epan taji ka tendjin ka nibondjin,
kidji a8i nd8e8emadjin kidji pi abidjibandjin nibo8inikag
ini8e kagi ikidondjin Kije Manidon kidji pidjinija8andjin?”

content: Misa dac oo8eni ka ojibiigadenig 8ina8a odji:
Kije Manido dac odikido8in, mi oo ka paba tibadjimo8ag, e ikido8ag panima a8iagog ki teb8eta8a8adjin Kije Manidon.
Kicpin dac 8idamageieg “Mi aa8e Jesos ka Tibendjigedj,” acitc kicpin teb8etameg kidei8akag Kije Manido egi abidjibaadjin Jesosan nibo8inikag, kiga ag8acimigo8a Kije Manido.
A8iag mega odeikag iji teb8etag, mi ke odji k8aiak8abamigodjin Kije Manidon. A8iag dac 8idamagedj “Mi aa Jesos ka Tibendjigedj,” mi ke odji ag8acimigodjin Kije Manidon.
Mazinadeni mega Kije Manido Omazinaiganikag:
Ka8in dac pakan apitendagozisi8ag Coda8innig acitc ega ka Coda8inni8i8adj. Ka Tibendjigedj mega kakina ini otibeniman, acitc okitci ca8eniman kakina a8ian ka pagosenimigodjin kidji 8idoka8adjin.
Mi mega oo ka ojibiigadenig Kije Manido Omazinaiganikag:

Kicpin dac a8iagog ega maci teb8eta8a8adjin Kije Manidon, adi dac kegi odji pagosenima8adjin kidji 8idokago8adjin? Kicpin ega ki nodage8adj e mikomagani8indjin, adi dac kegi odji teb8eta8a8adjin? Kicpin ega a8ian ki pi 8idamago8adjin Kije Manidon odikido8ini, adi dac kegi odji nodage8adj?
Kicpin ega a8iagog ijinija8agani8i8adj, adi dac kegi odji a8i tibadjimo8adj Kije Manidon odikido8ini? Mi e mazinadenig Kije Manido Omazinaiganikag:

content.text: igi8e ka pi tibadjimo8adj mino tibadjimo8inan.”Ésaïe 52.7

content: Ka8in dac kakina Coda8innig ododji odapinasina8a min8adjimo8ini. Mi gotc maia niganadjimo8inni Isaia kagi ikidodj:
Kidji gi teb8etag dac a8iag min8adjimo8ini, panima ki nodag. Min8adjimo8ini dac onodan apitc e kagik8ani8anig e mikomagani8indjin Jesos Christan.
Kegon dac ni8i k8ag8ed8e. Kana Coda8innig ododji nodasina8adok min8adjimo8ini? Ee, ogi nodana8a. Mi mega oo8eni mezinadenig Kije Manido Omazinaiganikag:
Kiabadj dac kegon ni8i k8ag8ed8e. Kana Israel a8iagog ododji nisidotasina8adok min8adjimo8ini? Mi oo kagi ojibiamogobanen Mois:

content.text: ega odji pejig kegoni ka kikendamo8adj.”Deutéronome 32.21
